'''SM-6''' was a sentient controlled droid onboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ship [[Steadfast (carrier)|''Steadfast'']], and was used to search destroyed vessels for traps before being salvaged. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] SM-6 was one of the droids involved in the finding of a operational datacore on the Star Destroyer ''[[Gnisnal]]'' that allowed for the discovery of the [[Black Fleet]].
